justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: IONM reduces intraoperative nerve injury; audiology role is specialized monitoring not rehab.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ABRET or ASET BCS-IOM; significant specialized training and experience requirements.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable exclusively in intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring; zero relevance in rehabilitation settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: IONM has CPT codes; ABRET certification required by some facilities for billing eligibility in intraoperative monitoring.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Consistent demand in IONM programs; required by some facilities but very narrow clinical setting.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Intraoperative patient cannot report; surgical team satisfaction relevant.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: IONM is delivered in ORs under hospital/surgeon contracts; no consumer cash-pay model.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: High-revenue B2B service billed to hospitals/insurers; per-case rates are strong.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Very rare credential; defines a small, lucrative niche of contracted IONM providers.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: IONM groups scale via employed technologists with supervising boarded providers; genuinely scalable.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Zero direct-to-consumer demand; demand is surgical/hospital-driven.
justifications.business.efficiency: Specialized fellowship-style training and exam; long runway.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized in audiology academia but narrower than ABA-clinical certs; modest faculty impact.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Active but small research community in IONM efficacy and methodology.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Adds depth to AuD neurodiagnostics/evoked potentials coursework.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Solid evidence supporting IONM in specific surgical procedures.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely required in AuD faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: High training cost relative to direct academic payoff.
